title: Epipsychidion
html_source:
A Shelley poem.

A cryptic poem on the nature of love, ideal love and poetry in the transcendental end of the romantic spectrum. The title refers to a soul within a soul and has echoes of Plato in the context of Stephen’s debate (Gifford).
